site.name: Nightingale Valley Holiday Centre
meta.title: Nightingale Valley Holiday Centre: stay in Rõuge, South Estonia
meta.description: Holiday houses, camping cabins and lakeside camping on the edge of Rõuge's Nightingale Valley. Views over the valley and lakes, a farm sauna by a waterfall, and seven lakes around.
hero.summer.line: Long evenings on the meadow, and three lakes to swim in within a short walk.
hero.summer.alt: The campsite meadow in summer, with cabins along the tree line
hero.autumn.line: Golden birches, red cabin roofs and Rõuge church across the meadow.
intro.title: Welcome to Rõuge's Nightingale Valley
intro.p1: We're on the edge of the Ööbikuorg valley in Rõuge, Võru County, with a wide view over the countryside and the lakes. Come for a quiet family holiday, or bring friends or a larger group.
intro.p2: The centre has two parts: a holiday village of five houses, each with a different level of comfort, and a campsite with camping cabins and private camping by the lake.

stay.title: Places to stay
stay.note: Prices are per night. Children aged 4–12 stay for less, and longer stays get a discount.
stay.large-houses.title: Large holiday houses
stay.large-houses.summary: Two houses with a kitchen and a terrace looking over the valley to the evening sun.
stay.large-houses.body: The Big House and the Kasega House each have two bedrooms with a shared hall, a shower and WC, and a kitchen with everything you need. The rooms have chairs and tables, and TV and wifi depending on the season. Both houses are heated and have a grill.

stay.family-house.title: Family house
stay.family-house.summary: A bedroom, a living room with a sofa bed, a kitchen, and its own seating area and grill outside.
stay.family-house.meta: Up to 6 people · shower and WC
stay.family-house.body: The family house has a bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and a shower room. The bedroom has a double bed, a bunk bed, a wardrobe and a desk. The living room has a sofa bed for two more, and the dining table seats six. The kitchen has a stove, fridge, microwave and the dishes you need. Outside there's a private seating area and a grill.

stay.small-houses.title: Small holiday houses
stay.small-houses.summary: The Yellow and the Red house: two bedrooms each, with a seating area and grill outside.
stay.small-houses.meta: 6–8 people · shower and WC · no kitchen
stay.small-houses.body: The Yellow and the Red house are identical, and each sleeps 6–8. Each has two bedrooms, with a wide bed and a narrow bed in each room and a loft sleeping place if needed, plus a shared hall, a WC and a shower. Outside there's a seating area and a grill.

stay.camping-cabins.title: Camping cabins
stay.camping-cabins.summary: Five heated cabins, each with a balcony. Showers, WCs and a summer kitchen are in a building close by.
stay.camping-cabins.meta: Up to 4 people · no bathroom inside
stay.camping-cabins.body: The campsite has five cabins for four. Four have a wide bed and a two-person bunk, and one has two bunks. All are heated, with a small desk and chairs inside and a balcony with a table and chairs. The building next door has WCs, showers, a washroom and a summer kitchen, and outside there are campfire sites, grills and a shelter for 20.

stay.lakeside-camping.title: Private camping by the lake
stay.lakeside-camping.summary: Your own tent on a quiet pitch at the lakeside.
stay.lakeside-camping.meta: Use of the campsite's summer kitchen and showers
stay.lakeside-camping.body: A pitch by the lake, away from other guests. The campsite's summer kitchen, showers, WCs and campfire sites are yours to use.

extras.title: More to do here
extras.sauna.title: Farm sauna by the waterfall
extras.sauna.body: A renovated sauna over 80 years old, heated by an old locomotive stove. Cool off under the waterfall, or in the lake 100 m away.
extras.sauna.price.small_stove: Sauna with the small stove, per hour (2 hours minimum)
extras.sauna.price.big_stove: Sauna with the big stove, per heating
extras.boats.title: Boats on the lakes
extras.boats.body: Rent a 4-seat pedal boat or a 3-seat rowing boat for Liinjärv and Suurjärv, which are joined.
extras.gatherings.title: Gatherings
extras.gatherings.body: Company summer days, family reunions and graduation parties, with room on the campsite for outdoor seminars and games.
extras.class_trips.title: Class trips
extras.class_trips.body: A good base for school trips in South Estonia, from €15 per pupil. We can arrange meals too.

groups.title: Groups & class trips
groups.intro: Looking for somewhere to stay with a class or a group in South Estonia? There are museums, sights and things for pupils to do close by.
groups.cabins.title: Staying in the camping cabins
groups.cabins.body: The camping cabins are the favourite for class trips. There are five cabins for four, each with a wide bed, a two-person bunk, heating and a small terrace. Close by are the summer kitchen, WCs, showers, campfire sites and a shelter for 20. We can arrange meals if you'd rather not cook.
groups.houses.title: Staying in the holiday houses
groups.houses.body: Teachers and the bus driver usually stay in the holiday houses. Every house has its own WC and shower, and the large ones also have a kitchen and terrace.
